title: Cybersecurity startup Calif says it used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover an RCE flaw in Java dubbed "Java4Shell"; Oracle has released a patch (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: Cybersecurity startup Calif says it used GPT-6 Cyber to uncover an RCE flaw in Java dubbed “Java4Shell”; Oracle has released a patch — The discovery by security company Calif shows A.I.'s ability to find gaping security holes in popular software.
